notes.title: Happy New Year🎄
notes.notes:
🎉 Happy New Year, Friends! 🎉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/4c7ba875fad3c76ea8e428ec31061cce60637bc0.gif[/img]

We hope 2025 brings joy, health, and adventure to you all! 
Looking back at the past year, we’re thrilled to share that it was a productive one for us. We've been working hard on new gameplay features, refining mechanics, and had the honor of showcasing The Frosted at several offline events.

However, we know there’s  room to improve. Development wasn't as fast as we wanted. This year, we’re focused on making faster progress. Also we'd like to share more news more often with new.

On an exciting note, new playtests are on the horizon! 🕹️ Stay tuned, as we’ll announce the exact time soon. Your feedback will help shape the game, and we can’t wait for you to experience what we’ve been working on.

Finally, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude to each of you for your support, patience, and encouragement. You’re the reason we keep going. Here’s to an amazing year ahead together!

💙 The Frosted Team

notes.notes:

Wait for news --- we are planning to gather some people for a closed playtest!

notes.title: The Idea of the Game and Concepts
notes.notes:
We rush into your news feed again to tell you about the watercolor hand-made indie game - The Frosted, the game which we love and are determined to push to the release. This time we want to share the background of the idea itself.

Ursula's adventures refer to the fairy-tale by H.C. Andersen, but the plot seems similar only at first glance. Like the brave little girl Gerda, our main character Ursula sets out on a journey to save her brother Trin. Magical creatures which are said to be in confrontation with the people stand in her way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/37fe6424cf99a150ff920827f4d4c085df8b038d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/be1a57dcbf2efc51ea7836aa557d532c9215583c.jpg[/img]

Ilva (whose prototype was the Snow Queen, and in the game called the Ice Queen) is the main antagonist of the backstory, in the fight with her the main character gets her first magical abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/6d9477e3247eb37f3f557156c51730213fae42ce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/f7b75d4c03e4e920fc897b136b1cca664e04a5ea.jpg[/img]

"The story began one dark winter night, in the snowstorm. On such nights, all people hide at their homes in the hope of preserving the remnants of heat. The Ice Queen captured the boy named Trin..."- Ursula's journey along the North Rim begins. Of course, Ursula will encounter a lot of mysteries and dangerous creatures.

The deep motive of the game is the confrontation between people and those who did not belong to the human race, but originally inhabited the region and rightfully considered it their home (we do not compare the gameplays here, but pay attention to the main plot idea: the confrontation between people and those who were not people, the violent occupation of the land). However, not everything is so smooth in relation to the main character: at some point Ursula loses her "kind" positive qualities and flirts with her powers too much.

As the player progresses, Ursula will have to make many difficult choices on the way to fulfilling her "cherished" goal.

If the story sounds catchy and you feel like learning more about Ursula's adventures, follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/frostedgame

See you soon!

notes.title: The Character Creation Concept
notes.notes:
[b]Is the process of external and internal changes of the main character of “The Frosted” logical?[/b]

Today we will tell you about the most beloved child, the most daring girl, and about the one whose strong will leads to a logical ending, no matter what it becomes as a result. Perhaps there will be a little snotty and blind adoration in the article. Be patient and we will tell you the most important things!


[b]The Idea[/b]
Ursula was born long before we came to the creation of the project. In the distant years, in her youth, our artist, Marina, drew a girl - perhaps these were echoes of herself in a cartoon form, perhaps, the creative foundation was simply being formed that time.
      [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/f3ba1f616f7cc6e5a65b48d2d6b75c614f8f42f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/042e318eb1a1a591a767c35a11ce908393df282d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/ede9b4c0a5d2a541b96950e776cbdad3798f0dc3.png[/img]


[b]Personality[/b]
There is a description of the name “Ursula” on the Internet. Very curious, by the way.
According to the description, the name “... endows its owner with a choleric temperament and a strong masculine character. Responsible and strong, energetic, persistent and efficient, generous and not envious, Ursula always knows how to live and what to do to solve a problem ... ”. This is exactly what our character is, she is seeking to bring the matter to the end, deferred to people only at the moment of extreme necessity, guided more by calculation than by feelings: although this description was not known to us at the time of thinking over the character and her behavior.


Ursula shows the player from the very beginning how strong and courageous she is in her decisions. How pure and sharp her mind is and how determined she is to, first, save her brother, then - make their parents come back.

 _________

[b]“On Paper” Realization[/b]
We had different ideas and a lot of disputes as to what the main character would look like.
For example, more detailed and western-style drawing (somewhat similar to Disney characters):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/65bedcfd12e248ec47db175dfdc2d96282495874.gif[/img]
A sort of Pocahontas:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/1ae507beb819d2fa5446c0c6ec330b930606a500.gif[/img]
More "folk-like" Ursula:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/a962d7e8f1e4de9414897eed471da4e4295fc80d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/4a2c5771a758f6df9d335302c9ce1beed1f3a28f.jpg[/img]
And finally, we decided that the main character of our game will look like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/bd0a9daad5cc338553f8180874edf0e71c7cac0c.gif[/img]


It is very difficult to find the “same” concept of a character, so that it is bright, resonant to some extent and memorable. The girl, to whom our today's article is dedicated, is not only our creation, but also an integral member of our team.
She can be drawn in different ways, but equally loved, cannot she?
When our artist gets tired of drawing the plot main art, she gives herself a break by drawing such cute sketches in the style of “Ursula in the spirit of Disney”.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/516872b860750569fe4767e646d8d99abd90bb96.png[/img]

[b]Feelings[/b]
Ursula loves her brother. Only next to him does she feel alive and happy, as in the old carefree times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/38bb08aa3c3cef31cb88cb10316bd541bf49abd3.jpg[/img]
    
[b]Regularity of Сhanges[/b]
Ursula begins her long journey being a little girl. She has a difficult burden: not only to defeat Ilva, the evil Queen of Ice, but also to harness the power gained in an unequal fight with the Queen.


Gradually, the character acquires many additional abilities that help her not only to defend herself, but also to attack the enemies, ruthlessly exterminating them on her way. Constantly working to improve on her abilities takes a lot of vitality. Crystals, magic, secret places, constant search, battles to the death: all this has its consequences for the development of the inner world. Having the new powers, Ursula herself is transformed: her behavior, the way of thinking and, of course, her appearance. Joy is gradually being reduced in her heart, and more and more dark thoughts creep in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/7ba183742fe8c61b8958491509a7d55e80aae14e.jpg[/img]

Pretty soon (late autumn 2021), everyone will be able to feel like Ursula and experience her transformation with her. Or maybe one will be able to influence her and the outcome of events in the Northern Region? .. Everyone has every opportunity to change the main character and influence the ending of the game. Here it is, a blank sheet in hers, and in your hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/cc0f01cf17962bf180abb155f91549f3b2672343.jpg[/img]
We are now preparing to launch the crowdfunding campaign that kicks off on December 1st at 4:00PM Moscow time on Crowdrepublic. If you like what we do, like our approach and determination to release the game no matter the outcome; you believe in the project as we do, and want to support us with some "coins", get very cool loot, join our team and realize your ideas in our project -- become our patron (residents abroad can also support us).

Be one among the first. Your support means a lot to us!

Have a great day!
The Frosted Team (Purple Brain Studio).

notes.title: Welcome
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to The Frosted Steam page![/b]
We are a team of enthusiasts from different parts of Russia who have united to create an exciting arcade adventure about a lonely girl who travels through a hostile magical world. The power that can forever change the inhospitable northern region will fall into her hands.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/cfba59458657d44b0ea7f495142bd24f4985a505.png[/img]
[b]
What's in store for the players?[/b]
Classic arcade gameplay, combined with watercolor graphics and a poignant story.
The Frosted is imbued with the spirit of classic games such as Bomberman and Legend Of Zelda together with new mechanics. The player will have to defeat the enemies, planting magic "bombs"; use a variety of defensive and attacking abilities; solve puzzles; upgrade the character; explore the levels in search of various items with the main characters, Ursula and her brother Trin, who helps her during their long journey along the North Region, as well as to make tough decisions that can radically change the ending of the game.
